source_boundaries: S2 specialization: p.variant=S2 gives folds2; source caller borrows exactly its two-element alpha array. Non-S2 paths are the identical original fallback.
Fixed array alpha[0]/alpha[1] and semantic[8]/semantic[9] reads are always in bounds. Moving their pure checked projections through source structural packing does not change errors/effects.

Constructor storage projects original factors/points fields; actual variant/extra field writes are explicitly reconstructed. Standard owning-allocation/unsafe-field frame: private partially initialized storage never escapes on failure; the fixed private extra copy has no log/allocation/effect and is unread until construction succeeds. No unsafe allocator reproof is asserted.
Actual ap0/ap1 source powers execute before allocation/point-row prefix. Actual low16 executes after that prefix, then inactive helper then Libra helper then original parts4/kappa tail.
Unchanged transaction work has immutable Prepared input and returns only the updated Accumulator. Direct source finishRelation is invoked on work success; errors/divergence bypass it identically.

PointPrefix/finalTail select the exact pinned source fragments. Candidate5 replacement inside them must be separately instantiated from its concrete checked consumers; c3/c14 endpoints alone do not claim candidate5 closure.
admission: Narrow source factoring/nominal-coordinate interpretation plus standard owning constructor/immutable frame. Common fields are identical computational source fragments, never old/new-equivalence or canonicality laws.
